## Download

| Computer | File |
| --- | --- |
| Mac with Apple silicon (M1, M2, M3, M4, M5) | `CodeWidget-mac-arm64.dmg` |
| Mac with Intel | `CodeWidget-mac-x64.dmg` |
| Windows | `CodeWidget-windows-x64-setup.exe` |
| Linux | `CodeWidget-linux-x86_64.AppImage` |

CodeWidget isn't signed by Apple or Microsoft yet, so the first launch shows a warning. See [Install](https://github.com/thomaslrw/codewidget#install) for the one-time step.
